description: This file is a Makefile fragment defining download methods, variables, and rules used in the OpenWrt build system for fetching and verifying source code. It includes functions for handling different version control systems (git, svn, cvs, hg, bzr, darcs), as well as download management with checksum verification, and support for different protocols and archives.

methods.name: dl_method_git
methods.description: Determines download method for Git repositories, returning 'github_archive' for GitHub URLs, otherwise 'git'.

methods.name: dl_method
methods.description: Guesses the download method based on the URL and protocol, selecting appropriate procedures for git, svn, cvs, hg, sftp, and others.

methods.name: dl_pack
methods.description: Selects the compression method for creating tarballs (bzip2, gzip, xz, zstd) based on file extension.

methods.name: dl_tar_pack
methods.description: Creates a compressed tarball from a directory using the specified compression.

methods.name: check_download_integrity
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of downloaded files by comparing their SHA-256 hash with the expected value.

methods.name: check_hash
methods.description: Checks if the SHA-256 hash of a file matches an expected value, issuing warnings or errors accordingly.

methods.name: check_md5
methods.description: Checks if the MD5 hash of a file matches an expected value, used for deprecated or alternative checksum validation.
